housing-numbers.notes: Total requirement 2,976 homes over 16 years. Allocated sites include: Moreton Station/Redbridge Pit (490), Wool (470), Lytchett Matravers (150), Upton (90). Committed housing includes completions 2018-2022 (483) plus extant permissions (305). Also includes neighbourhood plan allocations (289) and exception sites (47) plus small sites policy (139).
